class.name: FmodFile
class.brief_description: A handle to a raw audio file loaded into the FMOD Core system.
class.description:
FmodFile is an opaque reference to an audio file loaded with [method FmodServer.load_file_as_sound] or [method FmodServer.load_file_as_music]. It does not expose playback controls directly; use [method FmodServer.create_sound_instance] to get a playable [FmodSound] from the loaded file.
Unload the file with [method FmodServer.unload_file] when it is no longer needed.
